department: Department of Computer Science / College of Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants abroad have an April 1 Fall priority deadline (June 1 for international applicants in the U.S.; July 1 general Fall deadline listed on the catalog program page).
deadline.quote: Priority application deadlines for international applicants: | Fall Semester April 1 June 1

also.quote: Application Deadlines | Fall Semester Spring Semester Summer Semester July 1 November 1 April 1

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Computer Science or Data Science Subject Test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-admission supervisor agreement is not stated on the ENCS Computational Sciences catalog or Computer Science department pages.

funding.value: Competitive Graduate Assistantships (~20 hours/week) provide monthly stipends and most include tuition and fees, alongside Title III doctoral assistantships ($3,000/month plus in-state tuition for up to 4 years; POTUS Fellowships are limited to U.S. citizens/permanent residents).
funding.quote: Graduate Assistants are required to work approximately 20 hours per week. ... Appointments provide a monthly stipend and most include tuition and fees.

also.quote: $3,000 monthly stipend for doctoral students | In-state tuition while under contract

entry_route.value: Enter with either a relevant master's degree (minimum 3.00 GPA in catalog; 3.30 GPA noted on College ENCS pages) or a B.S. in engineering or computer science (minimum 3.30 GPA); 72 credits total beyond B.S. (up to 24 credits transferable with a master's).
entry_route.quote: Hold a Master of Science degree in an engineering discipline or computer science; a Master of Engineering degree; a master’s degree in a closely related field; or a Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline or computer science. | For unconditional admission: (a) the student must have a minimum cumulative grade point average (GPA) of 3.00 on a 4.0 scale for a master’s degree or 3.30 on a 4.0 scale for a bachelor’s degree

notes: Computational Sciences Concentration of the interdisciplinary ENCS Ph.D., including Data Science, Cybersecurity and Networking, and HPC and Bioinformatics specialties (per Department of Computer Science degrees page).
name: Engineering and Computational Sciences, Ph.D. (Computational Sciences Concentration)
